description: Get responses to one of your 5-question surveys. Only the owner can read them: pass `caller` = the owner. Responses are numbered from 1; returns numbers from..to-1 (at most 100 per call). Read-only; no signature. Optional `caller`: the account whose view to read (for caller-dependent results). Results are paginated with `offset` and `limit` (default 50, max 200).

caller.description: Optional account address (SS58) to run the query as

from_response_number.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

to_response_number.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

name: geode_surveys_get_survey_responses_5
title: Surveys: get survey responses 5
